mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > 0.5% MoM AND UNRATE < 0.2% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 0.2% MoM AND UNRATE < 0.2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
